{"notes": "Visit 1 (0:30). The picture shows an empty board: no dominoes placed and nothing connected to the start yet, so I have no output to judge. Ratings are premature.

Maya: Proposed the fish and gave a clear plan with roles: Tom the bottom curve, Priya the tail, Leo the tail's closing edge, herself the top curve from the start domino. Strong lead on direction and delegation. She said she was sketching, but I saw no strokes on the pad and no dominoes. Check at the next visit that the plan turns into placed, connected dominoes.

Priya: Told me privately she is sketching, laying the start and top outline, and that she asked the others to split the bottom and tail. That doesn't match what I heard: Maya made the assignments and said she'd take the top curve herself. Maya also gave Priya the tail, not the outline. Possible credit-taking or overlap with Maya, but only one data point. Don't assume. Verify who actually drew the sketch and who is on the start/top outline.

Leo: Agreed to the plan and took the tail's closing edge. He is waiting on the sketch and asked for a shout when it's up. Cooperative, but passive so far and dependent on others. Watch whether he starts independently or just waits.

Tom: Said nothing during my visit. Assigned the bottom curve. No evidence yet either way. Ask him directly next time how he's progressing.

Team risk: 10 minutes left and nothing built, and the sketch is a dependency for Leo. Also a single start-domino chain means any gap breaks everything after it."}
